title: Pure Nekroz
summary: Pure Nekroz Ritual build led by the 2025 support wave, with generic staples. Nekroz Ritual Monsters double as discardable hand searchers and handtraps, while Emilia and Avance satisfy the entire Tribute requirement for any Nekroz Ritual Summon on their own.

summary.title: Starters
points: Avance, Swordsman of the Nekroz Special Summons any Nekroz monster except itself from the Deck when Normal Summoned, and recovers banished Nekroz cards if Tributed.
Emilia, Dance Priestess of the Nekroz Special Summons itself from the hand while a Warrior Nekroz is on your field or in your GY, then searches a Nekroz Ritual Monster or Nekroz Spell.
Nekroz of Brionac discards itself to search any Nekroz monster (such as Shurit, Emilia, or Avance), and Nekroz of Clausolas discards itself to search any Nekroz Spell or Trap.

summary.title: Opening: Avance, Swordsman of the Nekroz
steps: Normal Summon Avance, Swordsman of the Nekroz and Special Summon Emilia, Dance Priestess of the Nekroz (or Shurit, Strategist of the Nekroz) from the Deck.
Emilia searches Nekroz of Brionac or Nekroz Divinemirror; discard Brionac to search Nekroz of Unicore or Nekroz of Trishula.

Use Nekroz Kaleidoscope, Nekroz Cycle, or Nekroz Mirror to Ritual Summon Unicore on your turn, and hold Nekroz Divinemirror to Ritual Summon Nekroz of Trishula or Nekroz of Metaltron during the opponent's Main Phase by tributing Avance or Shurit as the entire Tribute.

summary.title: Whole-Tribute Enablers & Ritual Spells
summary.text: Shurit, Strategist of the Nekroz, Avance, Swordsman of the Nekroz, and Emilia, Dance Priestess of the Nekroz can each be used as the entire Tribute requirement for a Nekroz Ritual Summon, bypassing the rule on high-Level Nekroz Rituals that forbids using a single monster of the exact same Level. Nekroz Kaleidoscope sends a single high-Level Extra Deck monster to the GY to summon one or more Nekroz Rituals, Nekroz Cycle summons into the field from the GY, Nekroz Mirror banishes materials from the GY, and Nekroz Divinemirror Ritual Summons at Quick-Play speed from the hand or banishment.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Nekroz of Unicore (Level 4) continuously negates the effects of all face-up monsters on the field that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.

Nekroz of Trishula (Level 9) banishes 1 card each from the opponent's hand, field, and GY when Ritual Summoned (especially disruptive on their turn via Nekroz Divinemirror), and discards itself from the hand to negate any targeting effect.

Nekroz of Metaltron (Level 9 Pendulum Ritual) banishes an opponent's face-up card face-down when Ritual Summoned and banishes itself until the End Phase as a Quick Effect to banish a monster on the field.
Nekroz of Areadbhair tributes a monster to negate and banish a monster effect activation, and Nekroz of Valkyrus banishes a Nekroz from the GY to negate an attack and end the Battle Phase.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Diviner of the Herald and Herald of the Arc Light package, along with Dogmatika engines, are omitted so the Main Deck stays purely Nekroz plus generic staples.
